messages.msg: Q16 proves on the article card's like count that setLikes(likes + 1) followed by setTimeout(() => console.log(likes), 3000) logs 0 three seconds later while the screen shows Likes: 1, and that three quick Likes with a timer each log 0, 1, and 2 while the screen shows 3. Q29 can keep the same timer and read the count from a ref to show the latest value, instead of building a new example.
